question_vi: Sự khác biệt giữa Authorization Server và Resource Server trong Spring Security 6?
question_en: What is the difference between an Authorization Server and a Resource Server in Spring Security 6?
answer_vi:
| | **Authorization Server** | **Resource Server** |
|---|---|---|
| Vai trò | Identity provider — **phát** token | Bảo vệ API — **validate** token |
| Trách nhiệm | Xác thực user, phát JWT, refresh, revoke | Verify token, check scope, cho/từ chối request |
| Library | `spring-authorization-server` | `spring-security-oauth2-resource-server` |
| Quan hệ | 1 AuthServer → N Resource Server |

**Resource Server config:**
```java
http.authorizeHttpRequests(a -> a
      .requestMatchers("/api/admin/**").hasAuthority("SCOPE_admin")
      .anyRequest().authenticated())
    .oauth2ResourceServer(o -> o.jwt(j -> j.jwkSetUri("https://auth/.well-known/jwks.json")));
```

**Validate (local, không gọi auth server):** lấy public key từ JWKS (cache) → verify chữ ký → check `iss`, `exp`, `aud`, `scope`.

**Thực tế 2026:** đa số dùng Keycloak (self-host) hoặc Auth0/Okta (managed); Spring app chỉ làm Resource Server. Tự viết Authorization Server chỉ khi cần đặc biệt (multi-tenant, custom flow).
answer_en:
| | **Authorization Server** | **Resource Server** |
|---|---|---|
| Role | Identity provider — **issues** tokens | Protects APIs — **validates** tokens |
| Responsibilities | Authenticates users, issues JWTs, refresh, revoke | Verifies tokens, checks scopes, allows/denies |
| Library | `spring-authorization-server` | `spring-security-oauth2-resource-server` |
| Relationship | One AuthServer → N Resource Servers |

**Resource Server config:**
```java
http.authorizeHttpRequests(a -> a
      .requestMatchers("/api/admin/**").hasAuthority("SCOPE_admin")
      .anyRequest().authenticated())
    .oauth2ResourceServer(o -> o.jwt(j -> j.jwkSetUri("https://auth/.well-known/jwks.json")));
```

**Validation (local, no auth-server call):** fetch public keys from JWKS (cached) → verify signature → check `iss`, `exp`, `aud`, `scope`.

**In 2026:** most teams use Keycloak (self-hosted) or Auth0/Okta (managed); Spring apps act as Resource Servers. Build your own Authorization Server only for special needs (multi-tenant, custom flows)
